prior: W-R29 four unused-context witness labels rejected both XOR heldout; this experiment pretests other, non-conjugate operations in a disjoint cohort without asserting universal four-label validity.
question: Does an early 24-conjugate modular-addition hypothesis, augmented by exactly up to four independent unused-context witnesses, resist three unfamiliar finite operation families rather than only XOR?
world: Sixteen latent 4-symbol episode contexts (all x0,x1 initial pair combinations), same second-order generation. seed mod4 =0 ADD4 (a+b)%4, =1 XOR4 a^b, =2 MUL4 (a*b)%4, =3 SUB4 (a-b)%4; hidden four-symbol relabeling from SHA256('W30/'+seed) byte0 modulo24. Training observations are ONLY explicitly queried t2 labels; test ticks3..31 are never revealed to model and are scored as 464 forecasts per accepted seed.
arms: ACTIVE_0: frozen W-R29 information-partition acquisition among fixed24 modular-addition conjugacy tables, stop on unique full predictive table or rejection, no unused-context witnesses
WITNESS_4: same frozen selected table, challenge at most four independent unqueried initial contexts sorted by deterministic SHA256 of observed pair, no refitting, reject on first mismatch
WITNESS_8: same with up to eight
WITNESS_ALL: full16-context complete independent consistency scan of every unqueried initial context (potential early rejection), reference only
metrics: For heldout seeds two per ADD4/XOR4/MUL4/SUB4: acceptance, false acceptance by out-of-family operation, genuine ADD 464/464 accepted accuracy, exact query labels, candidate fits, witness order/digests, operation confusion matrices, outcome fingerprints. Invalid if source fingerprints collide.
predeclared_classification: MULTIFAMILY_BOUNDED if WITNESS_4 accepts both ADD at464/464 and rejects all six out-of-family heldout and WITNESS_ALL confirms same. FALSE_FOUR_WITNESS if any out-of-family accepted under WITNESS_4. FALSE_EXHAUSTIVE if any out-of-family accepted under WITNESS_ALL. MIXED otherwise.
constraints: Prereg frozen before first-use, source and parent Git blob identity in CI, no candidate expansion beyond original24, no unqueried labels to selection/challenge ordering, first-use zip retained plus full Go test/build. No retries after result, no first-use reclassification, no accepted-ref changes or live activation.
claim_limit: Only four enumerated synthetic operations and finite seeded samples, not all possible alien rules or general intelligent inference.
